versions.changelog:
ai-model-router-v2 version 1.1.0

- Updated package metadata in package.json.
- No functional changes to code or documentation.

- Improved local model auto-detection logic in detector.py.
- Minor internal update; no changes to CLI, API, or configuration usage.
- Documentation and feature set remain unchanged.

ai-model-router-v2 2.0.0

- Major update combining the simplicity of model-router-premium and advanced features from ai-model-router.
- Adds automatic detection of local AI models (Ollama, LM Studio).
- Intelligent routing now considers task complexity, privacy triggers (API keys, passwords), and user model switching requests.
- Built-in cloud model registry with 7 options and optional JSON config for custom setups.
- Privacy mode automatically routes sensitive queries to local models for enhanced security.
- Lightweight, CLI-driven design with a simple Python API, preserving advanced features in ~200 lines of core code.
